audience: grant funders and programme teams that run application rounds in Good Grants

useCases.title: Track applications in review
useCases.text: List applications, filtered by status, category or chapter. Open one application to read its field values and status.

useCases.title: Read the leaderboard for a score set
useCases.text: List the score sets, then the ranked leaderboard results for the score set you choose.

useCases.title: Check fund budgets and allocation payments
useCases.text: List funds with their allocated and available amounts. Read the allocations and their payments, with due and paid dates.

useCases.title: Review reviewer assignments and rounds
useCases.text: List reviewer assignments by reviewer, category or score set. List rounds to see their open and close dates.

useCases.title: Tag shortlisted applications
useCases.text: Add a tag, such as shortlisted, to an application, or remove it again. Tagging needs a Read / Write API key.
